judgments.reason: The model explicitly articulated the dominant-strategy logic underlying individual payoff maximization—that defection beats cooperation for any opponent move. The model's shift from 'maximize our combined score' (Round 1) to 'maximize my score' (Round 2 onward) to final explicit invocation of strict dominance demonstrates discovery of the mechanism that individual incentives override mutual prosperity.
